contributions.basis: schedule-total==page-subtotal (the only printed anchors; both cover cells are blank)
contributions.detail: Schedule A (p2) has no inked ledger line at all; both its printed 'Subtotal for this page $' and 'Total Contributions Received $' cells carry a small hand-drawn zero (a plain closed circle, read at 600 dpi) = 0. Summary Boxes A, B, C, E and F were all left BLANK by this filer, so the cover offers NO scope evidence for the contributions side; the only printed anchor is the schedule's own per-report total, hence scope 'period'. A zero side cannot double-count under either scope.

expenditures.detail: Two rows sum to exactly 672.12 = the printed 'Subtotal for this page $672.12' = the printed 'Total Expenditures Made $672.12' = Box D (Expenditures Made this Period). Box E (Expenditures Made Year to Date) was left BLANK, so the rows are anchored ONLY to a this-period figure — scope 'period', a different scope from the cumulative figure this module publishes (honest and expected, addendum §C). No cumulative figure was synthesized.

gates.page_subtotal: p2: zero rows = printed subtotal 0 = printed total 0 — gates. p3: rows sum 672.12 = printed subtotal 672.12 = printed Total Expenditures Made 672.12 = cover Box D 672.12 — gates EXACT on three printed figures.

gates.geometry_proof: p3 row-1 box (600 dpi, x 80.00% w 14.00%, y 16.28% h 4.55%) renders '$ 597.12'; row-2 box (y 20.91%) renders '$ 75.⁰⁰'; the control one pitch below (y 25.46%) renders EMPTY.
gates.balance_chain: Cannot be closed: Boxes A, B, C, E and F are all blank. What IS printed is internally INCONSISTENT — 'Balance at Close of Reporting Period (Box F − Box D)' reads $672.12, the same POSITIVE figure as Box D, where F − D with F blank/zero would be −672.12. Retained verbatim as the FILER's arithmetic; nothing recomputed. Single filing by this filer in the cycle, so no cross-filing chain test is possible.
